children: Postal Realty closed acquisition of a 72-property USPS-leased portfolio for $27.75 million, funded with $25.75 million cash and $2.0 million in OP units.
Acquired 72-property Portfolio leased to USPS for $27.75M (excl. closing costs), effective Sept. 4, 2026.
Consideration: $25.75M cash and $2.0M in Operating Partnership units (85,300 OP Units issued).
Related-party detail: CEO Andrew Spodek owned 50% of the Portfolio and received ~$11.88M cash plus all OP Units.
Portfolio: 100% occupied, ~148,374 net leasable sqft (144,731 sqft leased to USPS), weighted avg rent $14.71/sqft.
